description: Run before sending a token to someone. Tokens go to the recipient's token account, not their wallet, and models can't work this address out in their heads. Works out the recipient's token account (ATA) for a wallet and token using the token's real program, checks whether it exists, and prices creating it if not. Inputs: wallet: The wallet that will own the token account (usually the recipient). token: The token's address. network (optional): Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/token_account.

network.description: Which Solana network to read. Default "mainnet-beta" (real money). Leave it out for mainnet. Use "devnet" only for test wallets.

token.description: The token's address. From find_token or tokens. Not a ticker.

wallet.description: The wallet that will own the token account (usually the recipient). The recipient's wallet address.

name: token_account
